title: Aladdin: exercises
subtitle: Five exercises on the text
label: Exercises
review: Written by Claude from the lesson text. Check the English and the answers before using it with learners.

items.q: Aladdin lived with his father in a small house.
The strange man was really a magician.
When the magician said strange words, the ground opened.
Under the ground, Aladdin found a new lamp.
The magician shut the stone door and left Aladdin inside.
The genie of the lamp was weaker than the genie of the ring.

items.why: “He was poor, but he was clever and lively.”

items.q: What did the magician want Aladdin to do?
options: Help him find something hidden underground
items.why: “He wanted Aladdin to help him find something hidden underground.”

items.q: What did Aladdin see in the dark place?
items.why: “He saw shining jewels. He saw gold and silver.”
“On his finger was a magic ring.”

items.q: What does the moral say is more valuable than riches?
items.why: “Moral: Wisdom and courage are more valuable than riches.”

blocks.title: 4. Open questions
blocks.note: These questions are open. Talk about your answers with your teacher or a classmate.

items.q: Without looking at the text, sum it up in three sentences.
items.model: A wicked magician took Aladdin to a dark place under the ground to find an old lamp. The magician left him there, but a genie from a magic ring took him home. The genie of the lamp gave Aladdin and his mother a better life.

items.q: Why did the magician shut the stone door?
items.model: Aladdin wanted to get out first, but the magician wanted the lamp first. He grew angry and left Aladdin inside.
He rubbed the magic ring on his finger. A genie appeared and took him safely home.

items.q: What did the genie of the lamp give Aladdin and his mother?
items.model: Food, clothes and a better life.

items.q: If you met a genie, what would you ask for? Why?

blocks.title: 5. Put in order
blocks.intro: Put the events in the order of the story.
items: A strange man said he was Aladdin's uncle
The ground opened and a stone door appeared
A genie came out of the magic ring
Aladdin rubbed the old lamp at home
